name: Vegas Vogue Woodworks
old_description: Premium materials. Precision design. Unmatched craftsmanship.
about:
Vegas Vogue Woodworks operates from a workshop in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The studio was founded by Mert, who believes design starts with how a room should feel. The company focuses on custom furniture and architectural millwork for high-end residential and commercial clients.

The workshop handles design, 3D modeling, CNC fabrication, hand finishing, and installation under one roof. They produce bespoke kitchens, walk-in closets, feature walls, offices, built-ins, and one-of-a-kind furniture pieces. All work is built in-house, from private estates in Laguna Beach and Newport Beach to commercial projects like a restaurant on Fremont Street in Las Vegas.

Clients include homeowners in exclusive neighborhoods across Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Orange County, as well as commercial clients seeking millwork that withstands heavy use. The studio serves both residential and commercial interior markets.

The company differentiates itself through a single-team model: every project is approved via a 3D model before cutting, fabricated with CNC precision, finished by hand with bookmatched veneers and hand-rubbed finishes, and installed by their own crew. This end-to-end control ensures consistency from private homes to the Vegas Strip.
